title: Smooth Stone Three: Building Predictability through Systems and Processes
summary: Achieve predictability, leverage, and consistency in life by utilizing structured processes and systems. Inspired by W. Edwards Deming and the post-WWII revitalization of Japan, this approach outlines how breaking complex tasks down into repeatable steps—such as the PDCA cycle (Plan, Do, Check, Act)—frees up cognitive energy and optimizes personal health, professional growth, and missionary success.
